text:
nora-devex: Quick one — the new next-langchain-starter sample is failing for TS users and also shows duplicate tokens in the live demo. Repro steps below.

ash-frontend: Oof, duplicate tokens + compile errors? TL;DR please.

nora-devex: Repro: clone sample, yarn && yarn dev, open /demo. In Chrome preview the chat shows repeated token fragments (e.g., 'Hel' 'Hel' 'lo'), and tsc errors in the sample: types from @redwood/inference-js disagree with our sample typings for stream responses.

sam-ml: Can you paste the minimal client snippet?

nora-devex: Sure:
```js
// client.ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const s = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood/llama-mini', input: prompt });
for await (const part of s) {
  render(part.text ?? part);
}
```
Type errors: SDK's types currently declare stream() yields AsyncIterable<string> in the browser build, but the sample expects AsyncIterable<{text: string}>. Python yields dict-like chunks.

felix-sdk: Hmm, we recently changed the JS helper to emit raw token strings for perf. That explains the compile mismatch. Why duplicate tokens though?

nora-devex: Network trace shows server sent SSE frames with incremental 'data:' lines that sometimes include overlapping tokens (edge case: generator yields pieces with carryover). Python-side parser merges SSE lines into a single token piece; our JS stream helper decodes per chunk and re-emits partial overlaps leading to duplicates when decoder boundaries slice between glyphs.

ash-frontend: So two fixes: (1) make sample type-safe with current SDK shape; (2) fix duplicate emission by changing helper to dedupe or align on token boundaries.

sam-ml: Dedupe is dangerous (could hide real repeats). Better: normalize bounding by joining contiguous pieces and running a lightweight delta-merge that only emits appended suffix. That's what our Python helper does.

felix-sdk: Agreed. I'll add an opt-in `stream.format: 'objects' | 'strings'` and keep current fast path default. Also add `stream.mergeStrategy: 'none' | 'suffix'` (default none). We won't change default behavior now.

leah-docs: For onboarding sample, please update client to be tolerant: detect whether parts are strings or objects and use a small merge shim that avoids duplicates. Add a short README note explaining the type mismatch and how to opt into SDK flags once released.

nora-devex: I'll patch the sample to use the shim and update TS types to handle both shapes (union). Will add a tiny test in examples/ci that mocks SSE frames with overlapping fragments to prevent regressions.

ci-bot: [ci] queued job 7223: examples/next-langchain-starter smoke test

felix-sdk: I'll open SDK PR INF-9003 to add the opts + tests and mark it experimental. Once we collect telemetry we can consider making object-mode default.

ash-frontend: Thanks — sample PR ping me for review. Adding the shim should unblock a bunch of new users hitting this in previews. :raised_hands:
